query: 我的订单 J26-00084 到哪了？
gold_sql: SELECT order_status FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00084'

query: J26-00010 这单现在做到哪一步了？
gold_sql: SELECT current_stage FROM prod.work_order WHERE order_no = 'J26-00010'

query: 我这单 J26-00044 还要多久能送到？
gold_sql: SELECT delivery_date FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00044'
note: 还没送到的单只有订单上的计划交付日期，配送记录里的实际送达日期是空的

query: J25-00213 怎么还没发货？
gold_sql: SELECT delivery_notes FROM svc.delivery WHERE order_no = 'J25-00213'
note: 生产已完工；没发货的原因（上次配送失败）只记在配送备注里

query: J26-00910 怎么还没做完？现在卡在哪道工序，什么原因？
gold_sql: SELECT current_stage, production_notes FROM prod.work_order WHERE order_no = 'J26-00910'

query: 我家柜子 J26-00038 是哪天送到的？
gold_sql: SELECT delivered_date FROM svc.delivery WHERE order_no = 'J26-00038'
note: 实际送达是 8 月 11 日；订单上的计划交付日期是 8 月 9 日，拿错字段会悄悄答错

query: 我这单 J26-00099 一共多少钱？
gold_sql: SELECT contract_amount FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00099'
note: 答合同金额；明细小计加起来是另一个数，不是这单谈定的价

query: J26-00108 我订了哪些东西，每样几件？
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, quantity FROM erp.order_item WHERE order_no = 'J26-00108'

query: 我那单 J25-00046 是不是被取消了？
gold_sql: SELECT order_status FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J25-00046'

query: J25-00036 之前报的缺件，现在处理得怎么样了？
gold_sql: SELECT service_status FROM svc.service_ticket WHERE order_no = 'J25-00036' AND issue_type = '缺件'

query: J25-00137 我们报的几个问题现在都处理好了吗？
gold_sql: SELECT issue_type, service_status FROM svc.service_ticket WHERE order_no = 'J25-00137'

query: J25-00759 补发的铰链寄出来了没有？哪天寄的？
gold_sql: SELECT shipped_date FROM svc.replacement_part WHERE order_no = 'J25-00759'
note: 补件名称是英文（Soft-close hinge set），按「铰链」两个字筛会查空

query: J25-00443 申请补发的件现在什么状态？
gold_sql: SELECT part_status FROM svc.replacement_part WHERE order_no = 'J25-00443'

query: 我有两单 J26-00010 和 J26-00011，分别什么时候交货？
gold_sql: SELECT order_no, delivery_date FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no IN ('J26-00010', 'J26-00011')
SELECT order_status FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00070'
note: 客户打的是小写单号，库里是大写；SQLite 的等号区分大小写

query: 你好，我们是 J26-00014 那个项目，柜子开始做了没有？工地那边催得紧
gold_sql: SELECT production_status FROM prod.work_order WHERE order_no = 'J26-00014'

query: J26-00039 是你们送货上门，还是要我们自己去提？
gold_sql: SELECT delivery_method FROM svc.delivery WHERE order_no = 'J26-00039'

query: J26-00024 现在什么进度了？
gold_sql: SELECT order_status FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00024'
note: 刚签单还没排产，生产库里没有这张单

query: J25-00068 是加急单吗？
gold_sql: SELECT is_rush FROM prod.work_order WHERE order_no = 'J25-00068'

query: J26-00119 的送货地址是哪个？我想核对一下
gold_sql: SELECT address FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00119'

query: Where is my order J26-00142?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J26-00142'

query: When will order J25-00988 be delivered?
gold_sql: SELECT delivery_date FROM erp.orders WHERE order_no = 'J25-00988'

query: Why hasn't J25-00094 shipped yet?
gold_sql: SELECT delivery_notes FROM svc.delivery WHERE order_no = 'J25-00094'

query: Has the replacement part for order J25-00060 been shipped?
gold_sql: SELECT shipped_date FROM svc.replacement_part WHERE order_no = 'J25-00060'
